title: Продвинутые условные: should you, were it not for, but for, provided, otherwise

why: Обычное if хорошо для бытовой речи, но в деловой переписке, договорах и литературном стиле нужны более лаконичные и формальные способы выразить условие: «если вдруг», «если бы не», «при условии, что», «иначе». В русском это работает похоже («Не будь вас...», «Если вдруг...»), и в английском такие конструкции звучат очень уверенно.
formation: • Should + подлежащее + V1 (вместо if): Should you need help, call me. (Если вдруг вам понадобится помощь, звоните.)
• Were + подлежащее + to + V1 / Were + подлежащее ...: Were I to lose my job, I would move. Were it not for + существительное, ...: Were it not for the noise, this café would be perfect.
• Had + подлежащее + V3: Had it not been for your help, we would have failed. (о прошлом)
• But for + существительное: But for the rain, we would have gone out. (без)
• provided / providing (that), as long as, on condition that: условие, которое должно выполниться.
• unless = if ... not: I won't go unless you come. otherwise = «иначе»: Hurry up; otherwise, you'll be late.
usage: 1. Should you ... — вежливое, формальное «если вдруг» (реальная, но маловероятная ситуация): Should the server crash, restart it. (Если вдруг сервер упадёт, перезапустите его.)
2. Were it not for / If it weren't for — «если бы не» (настоящее): Were it not for my team, this project would fail. (Если бы не моя команда, проект бы провалился.)

3. Had it not been for / But for — «если бы не» (прошлое): Had it not been for the traffic, we would have arrived on time. But for your advice, I would have made a mistake. (Если бы не ваш совет, я бы ошибся.)
4. Provided / as long as — «при условии, что»: You can use my laptop provided (that) you are careful. (Можешь пользоваться ноутбуком, при условии что будешь осторожен.)
5. Unless — «если только не»: I won't go unless you come with me.
6. Otherwise — «иначе», отдельное слово между двумя предложениями: Back up your files; otherwise, you may lose them.
7. Supposing / suppose — «а что если»: Supposing you lose your job, what will you do?
signalWords: should, were, had в начале предложения без if; but for, provided, providing, as long as, on condition that, unless, otherwise, supposing.
mistakes: ✗ Should you will need help, call me. → ✓ Should you need help (после should — V1, без will)
✗ If should you need... → ✓ Should you need... (if и инверсия вместе не ставятся)
✗ Unless you don't come, I'll go. → ✓ Unless you come, I'll go (unless уже содержит отрицание)
✗ Had it not been for you, I would fail. (о прошлом) → ✓ I would have failed
✗ Hurry up, otherwise you will to miss it → ✓ otherwise you'll miss it
remember: Should = «если вдруг», Were / Had = «если бы не», provided = «при условии», otherwise = «иначе».

items.prompt: ___ you need any help, call me. (формально, вместо if)
items.answer: Should

items.prompt: ___ it not been for your help, I would have failed.
items.answer: Had

items.prompt: ___ for the rain, we would have gone hiking.
items.answer: But

items.prompt: You can borrow my car ___ you drive carefully. (при условии)
items.answer: provided / providing / as long as

items.prompt: Take an umbrella; ___, you'll get wet.
items.answer: otherwise

items.prompt: ___ it not for this bug, the app would be perfect.
items.answer: Were

items.prompt: I'll come ___ I'm too busy. (если только не)
items.answer: unless

items.prompt: ___ I to lose my job, I would move to another city.
items.answer: Were

exercises.instruction: Перепишите условное предложение с инверсией Should (без if)

items.prompt: If you need more information, contact us.
items.answer: Should you need more information, contact us.

items.prompt: If anyone calls, please take a message.
items.answer: Should anyone call, please take a message.

items.prompt: If the server crashes, restart it.
items.answer: Should the server crash, restart it.

items.prompt: If you have any questions, let me know.
items.answer: Should you have any questions, let me know.

items.prompt: If he arrives early, ask him to wait.
items.answer: Should he arrive early, ask him to wait.

items.prompt: If there is a problem, call me.
items.answer: Should there be a problem, call me.

items.prompt: If it rains, the event will be moved indoors.
items.answer: Should it rain, the event will be moved indoors.

items.prompt: If you change your mind, tell me.
items.answer: Should you change your mind, tell me.

exercises.instruction: Перепишите предложение, используя конструкцию в скобках

items.prompt: If it weren't for the deadline, I would stay longer. (Were it not for...)
items.answer: Were it not for the deadline, I would stay longer.

items.prompt: If it hadn't been for your advice, I would have made a mistake. (Had it not been for...)
items.answer: Had it not been for your advice, I would have made a mistake.

items.prompt: Without your help, we would have lost the client. (But for...)
items.answer: But for your help, we would have lost the client.

items.prompt: Without the internet, our work would be impossible. (But for...)
items.answer: But for the internet, our work would be impossible.

items.prompt: If it hadn't been for the traffic, we would have arrived on time. (Had it not been for...)
items.answer: Had it not been for the traffic, we would have arrived on time.

items.prompt: If it weren't for my team, this project would fail. (Were it not for...)
items.answer: Were it not for my team, this project would fail.

items.prompt: We would have caught the train if the delay hadn't happened. (But for...)
items.answer: But for the delay, we would have caught the train.

items.prompt: If it weren't for the noise, this cafe would be perfect. (Were it not for...)
items.answer: Were it not for the noise, this cafe would be perfect.

exercises.instruction: Объедините предложения, используя слово в скобках

items.prompt: You can use the car. You return it by six. (provided that)
items.answer: You can use the car provided that you return it by six. / You can use the car provided you return it by six.

items.prompt: We'll start at nine. It rains. (unless)
items.answer: We'll start at nine unless it rains.

items.prompt: Hurry up. You'll miss the bus. (otherwise)
items.answer: Hurry up; otherwise, you'll miss the bus. / Hurry up, otherwise you'll miss the bus.

items.prompt: You can stay here. You are quiet. (as long as)
items.answer: You can stay here as long as you are quiet. / You can stay here as long as you're quiet.

items.prompt: I won't go. You come with me. (unless)
items.answer: I won't go unless you come with me.

items.prompt: Back up your files. You may lose them. (otherwise)
items.answer: Back up your files; otherwise, you may lose them. / Back up your files, otherwise you may lose them.

items.prompt: I'll lend you money. You pay me back soon. (providing)
items.answer: I'll lend you money providing you pay me back soon. / I'll lend you money providing that you pay me back soon.

items.prompt: What will you do if you lose your job? (start with Supposing)
items.answer: Supposing you lose your job, what will you do?

items.prompt: Если вам вдруг понадобится помощь, звоните мне.
items.answer: Should you need any help, call me. / Should you need help, call me.

items.prompt: Если бы не ваша помощь, мы бы не закончили проект.
items.answer: Had it not been for your help, we wouldn't have finished the project. / But for your help, we wouldn't have finished the project. / If it hadn't been for your help, we wouldn't have finished the project.

items.prompt: Ты можешь пользоваться моим ноутбуком при условии, что будешь осторожен.
items.answer: You can use my laptop provided (that) you are careful. / You can use my laptop as long as you're careful.

items.prompt: Поторопись, иначе опоздаешь на самолёт.
items.answer: Hurry up, otherwise you'll miss the flight. / Hurry up, otherwise you'll miss your flight.

items.prompt: Если бы не этот баг, приложение работало бы идеально.
items.answer: Were it not for this bug, the app would work perfectly. / If it weren't for this bug, the app would work perfectly.

items.prompt: Я не пойду, если только ты не пойдёшь со мной.
items.answer: I won't go unless you come with me. / I won't go unless you go with me.

items.prompt: Если бы вы вдруг передумали, дайте мне знать.
items.answer: Should you change your mind, let me know. / Were you to change your mind, let me know.

items.prompt: Если бы не пробки, мы были бы уже дома.
items.answer: But for the traffic, we would be home by now. / Were it not for the traffic, we would be home by now.
